usage.applicability: Offline SkyDiscover policy search only for BlindAssist-owned real ordered portal-state evaluators; it is not a perception or route-authority source.
usage.source_scope: SkyDiscover main merged locally at c475ed4009071159b4d5b777715f1af9202cebba on 2026-08-28. The obsolete oracle L10 benchmark family is excluded from the current route rather than migrated.
usage.project_application: Use a new evaluator whose only target observations are BlindAssist support-ray and temporal-belief SEARCH, SET_VALUED, COMMIT, and REACQUIRE states from real ordered portal views.
usage.modifications: Search only the active-observation and commitment policy block. Use AdaEvolve Pareto objectives for correct portal retention/commit/reacquisition versus false commits, instruction burden, and runtime; wrong-portal or premature ARRIVED remains a hard invalidity.
usage.expected_effect: Discover active disambiguation policies that improve task completion without buying precision through abstention or relying on OCR-only identity.

evaluation.setup: A new SkyDiscover policy/evaluator contract and one real non-OCR two-frame IFC reverse-side prefix were frozen. Evaluator truth is private and mechanics fixtures are explicitly non-scientific.
evaluation.effect: The first real prefix retained correct portal-set truth in 0/2 frames. The raw belief falsely changed SET_VALUED to COMMIT on a large foreground/escalator proposal; requiring center-and-approach scale consistency changed it to SET_VALUED to SET_VALUED and removed that observed false commit. Correct localization was not recovered, so SkyDiscover search is not authorized yet.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This is an integration decision, not evidence that SkyDiscover improves real BlindAssist perception, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Current Optimize/Synthesize positioning, evaluators, artifacts, Pareto support, and search methods.
New perception-policy contract with hard false-commit and arrival gates plus explicit AdaEvolve Pareto objectives.
First real non-OCR ordered-view prefix: 0/2 portal-set truth retention before the scale-consistency belief replay.
Frozen portal-set truth and the reverse-side proxy claim boundary.

history.change: Revised SkyDiscover from a narrow Best-of-N/EvoX policy search role to an AdaEvolve Pareto real-perception bridge, while keeping Synthesize separate from the algorithm search loop.

Excluded the obsolete oracle benchmark family, landed the new perception-policy contract, and blocked search after the first real prefix exposed 0/2 portal truth retention. Added an approach-scale causal gate that removes the observed false commit without claiming localization.
